title: The Dictionary of Dreams: Every Meaning Interpreted
subtitle: Every Meaning Interpreted
authors_contributors: Sigmund Freud (selections from The Interpretation of Dreams)
Prudence J. M. Theriault (Top-Ten Common Dreams section)
publisher: Wellfleet Press (imprint of The Quarto Group)
description: A practical illustrated dream-interpretation reference combining classic texts with a heavily updated A–Z dictionary of dream symbols. Expanded and modernized from Gustavus Hindman Miller’s 1901 classic 10,000 Dreams Interpreted, with contemporary additions (cell phones, computers, televisions, etc.). Claims coverage of more than 15,000 dream symbols.

sections: The Top-Ten Most Common Dreams and Their Meanings (by Prudence J. M. Theriault)
Selections from The Interpretation of Dreams (Sigmund Freud)
How to Keep a Dream Journal
Introduction to Dream Symbols (from Miller’s original preface)
A–Z Dictionary of Dream Symbols (updated/revised Miller)

key_features: Analysis of the 10 most common dreams
notes: Not a pure reprint of Miller’s 1901 book. Expanded, revised, and modernized compilation. Physical copy shown is a library edition (Campbelltown City Library). Do not rehouse copyrighted dictionary text.
